content:
为 [Oh The Biomes We've Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone) 的 [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) 砧板添加更多配方

- 所有木材类型的树皮剥离与回收
- 更多染料来源：
    - 原本仅能合成 1 个染料的鲜花
    - 蓝莓

![木材切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ickBpNUE/images/5ee18d8842874b754f98b0b10bdab3019fe982a6.png) ![花朵切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ickBpNUE/images/908157c414776f5d680e041c4110c6fc8205477f.png) ![蓝莓切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ickBpNUE/images/a49fa272b63d7828a0d6cb92c47997e4ca391d06.png)
